text:
ryan: Quick FYI from post-launch triage for 3.1.0 — board shows 32 items: 4 P1s, 9 P2s. BetaCorp reported a reranker regression causing low relevance for their top-k feed. They want a patch or an ETA. Link: https://redwood/board/3.1.0

neha: Thanks. Looks like the regression surfaced after the KV-cache change in runtime. I can reproduce locally with their payload. Proposal: ship a targeted rollback for the KV-change only for BetaCorp via a customer-scoped feature flag while we investigate. That buys time without holding whole release.

sam: Strong +1 for feature-flag route. Ops can toggle per-customer. Question: does this become an opt-in? BetaCorp wants automatic fix, not opt-in.

evan: Ops note: per-customer toggles are ready in staging; we need a runbook for toggling and monitoring. Also we should limit the rollback window to 72h unless root cause found.

liz: Product perspective: if we ship a short rollback for BetaCorp, we should escalate the fix for the underlying reranker bug into the sprint as a hot item. Also, any enhancements that improve feed relevance should be promoted (they tie to retention).

ryan: Proposed plan (short):
- Immediate: enable per-customer rollback flag for BetaCorp (ops) — owner: evan
- Hotfix lane: root-cause patch for reranker (eng) — owner: neha
- Backlog lane: prioritise relevance-enhancements that help retention (product) — owner: liz
- Communication: CS/Account to message BetaCorp w/ETA window today (sam)

neha: Acceptance criteria for hotfix: repro case fails on canary with fix applied; perf parity (+/-10ms p99); all E2E tests pass. If canary meets thresholds we merge and flip flag globally.

sam: I'll draft the customer note: conservative ETA Tues-Thu next week, mention we're enabling a flag immediately for them and will validate with their team in staging.

evan: release-bot: Toggle request queued for BetaCorp rollback-flag. Provisioning a dedicated canary slice for that flag for faster validation.

liz: For backlog grooming: I'm moving three feed-related enhancements up (personalization tweaks, rerank explainability bits, cached pre-rank) — will break into sub-tasks and estimate sizes. Recommend one of them be included as a small spike this sprint to reduce risk.

ryan: Tradeoff discussion: do we pull one enhancement into the hotfix sprint vs preserve focused attention on the reranker root cause? I lean toward keeping hotfix sprint minimal (only the bug) and scheduling a 3-day spike for the highest-impact enhancement.

neha: Agreed. Keep hotfix focused. We risk regressions if we expand scope. Spike to be timeboxed 3 days, no merge without sign-off.

sam: CS ask: if BetaCorp validation passes, can we offer a temporary SLA credit if it impacted production metrics? Need approval from finance/legal — I'll start the convo.

evan: Ops ask: please avoid simultaneous large infra merges during canary window; we'll coordinate a freeze window 6h around flips. Also will set alerts: error_rate > 0.3% or p99 +40ms triggers rollback to flag state.

liz: Who owns the PR for the KV-change rollback? neha?

neha: I'll open a PR in the next hour: draft -> https://redwood/repo/pulls/512. It will include a small runtime toggle and tests.

release-bot: CI status: PR 512 - checks pending. Canary slice allocation in progress.

ryan: Timeline recap:
- Now: enable per-customer flag for BetaCorp + message (sam)
- +1h: PR opened by neha (draft), QA smoke (evan/ops)
- +4h: Canary run and quick perf checks (monitoring)
- +24-72h: keep flag up while root cause is fixed; if ok, flip globally

sam: I'll send the customer note now and put a calendar slot for staging validation tomorrow afternoon.

neha: Starting root-cause debug now; will post traces and a short RCA draft to the ticket.

ev an: Noted — pausing non-essential infra deploys for next 6h.

liz: I'll queue the three feed enhancements into grooming and set the spike ticket.

ryan: OK great. If anything fails in canary we reconvene in this thread. Otherwise, I'll mark the board lanes and update execs after the canary results. :rocket:
